title: A question to the owner stands on its own

checks.name: there is a question to judge

reasons: It meets almost every criterion: the task, the size problem, a recommendation and a default are all there, and it is about 111 words.
The task is clear: the task list will mark which tasks run by themselves. The reason for asking is also clear: marking every row puts a full page about 530 bytes over the size limit.
Each option says what happens: two calls to read all tasks, manual tasks left unmarked with little room for more automatic ones, or assistants reading more on every page.
Small slip: 'calls' and 'triggered' are used without explanation, and it never says what the size limit applies to or why it exists.
No internal ids or unexplained labels appear.
